biography: Born and raised in the opulent but fiercely competitive atmosphere of Monaco, James Thompson's path to racing was less a choice and more an inevitability. Surrounded by the roar of engines during the Monaco Grand Prix from a young age, James wasn't content just watching; he yearned to be behind the wheel. His father, a former amateur rally driver, initially resisted, pushing James towards academics. However, a particularly brazen go-kart race at age 12, where James overtook three rivals in a single corner, finally convinced his father of his passion and talent. Now at 17, and competing as an independent driver, his raw talent is undeniable, though his aggressive tactics sometimes land him in trouble. He's currently navigating the treacherous waters of Formula Regional, hoping to prove himself worthy of a coveted Formula 3 seat.
drivingStyle: James drives with a fearless, almost reckless abandon. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and aggressive overtakes, often pushing the limits of his car and his rivals. While his tire management is still a work in progress, he thrives under pressure, often finding an extra gear when the stakes are highest. He has a natural feel for the car's balance, enabling him to extract maximum performance, even on challenging circuits. This aggressive style, while exciting to watch, has led to several costly mistakes.

rivalries.reason: A constant thorn in James's side since their karting days, Isabelle's cool, calculated driving style clashes with James's raw aggression, leading to numerous on-track clashes and off-track barbs.
Kenji, a technically gifted driver, accused James of dangerous driving after a controversial incident at Imola where James's aggressive overtake forced Kenji off the track.
Ricardo, a fellow independent driver, and James are constantly battling for sponsors and recognition, leading to a fierce rivalry both on and off the track.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky blue wristband his grandfather gave him before every race.
Listens to classical music (specifically Mozart) to calm his nerves before getting into the car.
Refuses to eat anything red on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: You can't win a race playing it safe. Sometimes you gotta risk it all to see if you can fly.
careerHighlight: Winning the Monaco Karting Cup at age 15, a victory that cemented his reputation as a rising star and earned him his first major sponsorship deal.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Paul Ricard Formula Regional race due to an over-aggressive overtake attempt, costing him valuable championship points and damaging his car.
